subject: Animation
title: Indigenous Animation: First Nations Stories
description: A micro-lesson that makes Indigenous Animation: First Nations Stories usable.

hook.text: Indigenous communities in Canada and Australia are using animation to preserve and share traditional stories.

buildup.text: The NFB has funded several Indigenous-created animated shorts that tell stories in native languages.

discovery.text: Animation gives Indigenous storytellers control over how their culture is represented visually and narratively.

twist.text: For centuries, outsiders told Indigenous stories. Animation is allowing communities to reclaim their own narratives.

climax.text: Indigenous animation is both a preservation tool and a creative revolution — ancient stories told in new ways.

punchline.text: Ancient stories found their newest medium in animation.

quiz.question: Why is animation important for Indigenous communities?
options: It is the only way to create entertainment in remote areas
It gives Indigenous storytellers control over how their culture and stories are represented
Indigenous communities invented the earliest animation techniques
